summary: Bitfufu Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce its unaudited Bitcoin production and operational updates for May 2026. The filing details month-over-month changes in Bitcoin production (177 BTC, up 22.1%), self-mining output (90 BTC vs 32 BTC in April), and holdings (1,855 BTC). There is no mention of a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation. This is a routine operational update for a Bitcoin mining company.
